remove.title: Remove selected roles
remove.text: Drop the selected roles. A role that still owns objects or holds privileges is refused: reassign or drop what it owns from its edit page first.
remove.databases: Drop the databases that have the same names as the roles.

database.title: Database for role
database.create: Create database with same name and make the role its owner.

attributes.title: Role attributes
attributes.note: Note: PostgreSQL attribute names are expressed in English.
attributes.limits_note: Note: A connection limit of -1 (or empty) removes the limit; an empty VALID UNTIL never expires.

hint.rolcanlogin: Allows logging in: a role with LOGIN is a user.
hint.rolinherit: Uses the privileges of the roles it is a member of without SET ROLE.
hint.rolsuper: Bypasses every permission check, except the right to log in.
hint.rolcreaterole: Allows creating, altering and dropping other roles and granting membership in them.
hint.rolreplication: Allows connecting for streaming replication and creating replication slots.
hint.connlimit: Limits the number of concurrent connections the role may make.
hint.valid_until: The date and time after which the role's password stops being valid.

hint.admin: WITH ADMIN: the member may grant and revoke membership in the role.
hint.inherit: WITH INHERIT: the member uses the role's privileges without SET ROLE.
hint.set: WITH SET: the member may SET ROLE to the role.

edit.title: Edit privileges: Role
edit.current_user: Note: You are attempting to edit privileges of the role with which you are currently logged in.

reassign.title: Reassign or drop owned objects
reassign.note: Both work in the database chosen; DROP OWNED also revokes the role's privileges there. A role can be dropped once nothing in any database depends on it.

privileges.title: Privileges
privileges.no_databases: The role holds no privileges on any database.
privileges.updated: The privileges of {{grantee}} have been updated.
privileges.with_grant_hint: The role may grant the privilege on to others.

hint.REFERENCES: Allows creating foreign keys that refer to it.
hint.MAINTAIN: Allows VACUUM, ANALYZE, CLUSTER, REINDEX, REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW and LOCK TABLE.

privileges.note: Note: PostgreSQL privilege names are expressed in English.

defaults.title: Default privileges
defaults.none: New objects get the built-in default privileges.

wizard.title: Grant wizard
wizard.note: Grants the privileges checked on every object chosen that accepts them; privileges already held are kept.
wizard.name: Name
wizard.choose_objects: Choose objects to see the privileges they accept.
wizard.no_role: Choose a role to grant the privileges to.
wizard.granted_one: The privileges have been granted to {{grantee}} on {{count}} object.
wizard.granted_other: The privileges have been granted to {{grantee}} on {{count}} objects.

tablespaces.title: Tablespaces
tablespaces.drop_warning: A tablespace can only be dropped once it is empty in every database.

create.title: Create tablespace
create.name: Tablespace name
create.location_hint: An absolute path to an existing, empty directory owned by the PostgreSQL server's operating-system user.

move.title: Move objects
move.owned_by: Owned by (all when none is chosen):
move.nowait: NOWAIT: fail at once rather than wait for locks
move.moved: The objects in {{database}} have been moved.

contents.title: Objects in this tablespace
contents.show: List the objects stored in it in every database
contents.empty: Nothing is stored in this tablespace.
contents.name: Name
